name: token-diet
description: Keeps Claude Code sessions cheap: context and usage band with burn-rate and weekly-pace projections, escalating handoff nudges, a spawn gate for large contexts, a 95% guard that writes the handoff itself, a usage log that measures what the limit counts, and Sonnet for subagents.

contextNudgeTokens.title: Context nudge (tokens)
contextNudgeTokens.description: Nudge to write the handoff and /clear each time context passes another multiple of this; the second and later nudges are firmer.

softLimitPercent.title: Soft limit (%)
softLimitPercent.description: 5-hour/weekly usage at which Claude is told to write the deliverable and handoff now.

hardLimitPercent.title: Hard limit (%)
hardLimitPercent.description: 5-hour/weekly usage at which tool calls are blocked, except reading and writing the handoff file.

handoffFile.title: Handoff file
handoffFile.description: Handoff file path, relative to the project folder. Not used in a project that has a handoffs/ folder: there each session writes handoffs/<date>-<topic>-<session id>.md.

autoHandoff.title: Automatic handoff
autoHandoff.description: When the hard limit stops the main session mid-work and its handoff is not current, write the handoff file from one tool-less side call over the conversation instead of asking Claude to write it.

usageLog.title: Usage log
usageLog.description: Log each usage reading with the tokens used since the one before (counts only, no content) to token-diet/usage/ in your Claude Code config folder. /token-diet-usage reports what the log says about how the limit counts cache reads.

subagentModel.title: Subagent model
subagentModel.description: Model forced on general-purpose/Explore/Plan/claude subagents, and on any subagent asking for opus/fable, unless your last prompt asks for opus or fable or keepStrongFor matches. 'off' disables.

spawnGateTokens.title: Spawn gate (tokens)
spawnGateTokens.description: Above this context size the main session cannot start agents until its handoff file is up to date. 0 turns the gate off.

runwayMinutes.title: Runway (minutes)
runwayMinutes.description: Also warn when the 5-hour window would reach the hard limit within this many minutes at the current burn rate. 0 turns the warning off.

keepStrongFor.title: Keep strong model for
keepStrongFor.description: Comma-separated words; a subagent whose type or description contains one keeps the model it asked for (e.g. 'security, branch review').
